reason_summary: Prompt asked for a parallel quote-and-bind rule-pack / dictionary and a premium-calculation engine. KYE already governs insurance authority via kye:rule-pack:insurance-underwriting-claims; a parallel distribution pack violates §0, re-mapping Colorado SB21-169 / NAIC / EU AI Act insurance / FCA Consumer Duty violates §70, and a rating engine violates the honest scope (KYE governs whether the override, the discount, or the bind may proceed — it does not calculate premiums). Refusing all three.
remediation_hint: Build it as a Governed Agent PRODUCT that governs the rating-factor override, the discount authority, and the quote-to-bind moment as an explicit finality gate against the EXISTING kye:rule-pack:insurance-underwriting-claims verdict. Add only agent-product artefacts (§52 binding, principal, refusal, product row, SKU, pricing, ™, gate) and BIND — never re-map — the existing insurance frameworks.
